posts.author: The Verge AI
posts.text: OpenAI agents tried to ‘bruteforce’ a UN website. Security researcher Rowan Howard-Jones says that OpenAI agents scanned the UN Conference on Trade and Development's (UNCTAD) statistics site over 16,000 times between April and June. While the incident doesn't quite rise to the level of the Hugging Face hack, or the recent attacks on US government sites, it's yet another concerning example of AI […]

posts.author: Bloomberg Tech
posts.text: Nvidia Debuts System Designed to Stop AI Agents From Going Awry. Nvidia Corp. introduced a new double-layered artificial intelligence security system that it says would’ve prevented the recent high-profile breach of Hugging Face by OpenAI’s AI models.

posts.author: Bloomberg Tech
posts.text: Nvidia Rolls Out New Tools to Keep AI Agents in Line. Nvidia is rolling out two open-source software security tools designed to control what AI agents can access in real time and shut them down when they break the rules. The company says this would’ve prevented the recent high-profile breach of Hugging Face by OpenAI’s artificial intelligence models. Neil Campling reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

posts.text: AI Breaches Add to Safety Fears as Trump Meets Anthropic Chief. Global anxiety over artificial intelligence risks has intensified following fresh disclosures about a far wider range of breaches by advanced AI models, setting the stage for a high-stakes meeting between Anthropic PBC Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei and President Donald Trump.

posts.author: Bloomberg Tech
posts.text: The Stocks That Could Survive an AI Bust. Merryn Somerset Webb speaks with Blue Whale Growth Fund Chief Investment Officer Stephen Yiu about what could derail the artificial intelligence boom — and where investors might look if it does. They discuss whether today’s enthusiasm is masking an earnings bubble, how investors can diversify beyond AI and which emerging technologies and geopolitical risks could reshape the market next. (Source: Bloomberg)
